composer.turnFailedFallback: Character did not finish the last reply.
composer.incompleteBody: The character's response was cut short.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: Responses will resume automatically once you're back online.

consent.title: Your privacy & data
consent.body: Under Indonesia's PDP Law 2022, we only process personal data with your consent. Only authentication and session storage are mandatory. Analytics and personalisation are optional.
consent.sheetDescription: You can change these anytime in Settings → Privacy.
consent.essentialDescription: Authentication, chat sessions, security. Required for the app to work.
consent.analyticsDescription: Anonymous aggregate data to improve response quality and performance.
consent.personalisationDescription: Remember your persona, mood, and style for character recommendations.

selector.title: Select MC (Main Character)
selector.anonymousHint: Start with a simple MC without a profile
selector.emptyHint: Create a new profile with the "Create New" button
selector.charactersHint: Create characters on the Characters page

editor.description: Create the main character (MC) for your story. The MC is the persona you will use while playing.
editor.nameError: Please enter a name for your MC.
editor.personalityError: Please enter a personality description for your MC.
editor.avatarHint: Optional. Enter an image URL for the MC's avatar.
editor.defaultHint: The default profile will be automatically selected when starting a new story.
editor.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this MC profile?
editor.saveFailed: Failed to save MC profile. Please try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.pushDescription: Notify me when a favourite character replies outside the app.
notifications.inAppPingDescription: Vibrate or play a sound when a streamed reply finishes.
notifications.weeklyDescription: Email / push once a week when new characters are released.
notifications.footerNote: Preferences are stored on this device. Multi-device sync will activate when the server notification endpoint is available.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.dataSaverDescription: Disable aurora and background animations. Best for slow networks.
appearance.reduceMotionDescription: Reduce transition animations. Your OS may also control this.
appearance.batteryNote: When battery drops below 15%, Project Neigo automatically disables background animations to save power.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.exportDescription: Download all transcripts, characters, and account metadata.
privacy.exportToastDescription: We'll email the JSON file within 48 hours per PDP Law.
privacy.deleteDescription: Permanently delete your data within 30 days.
privacy.deleteToastDescription: Check your inbox to complete account deletion.
privacy.revokeDescription: The consent banner will appear again.
privacy.footerNote: Project Neigo complies with Indonesia's Law No. 27/2022 on Personal Data Protection.
